table_title: Extremes.--Maximums and minimums (contents in acre-feet, elevation in feet) for the water years 1961-65
site_name: Bucks Lake near Bucks Lodge, Calif.
location_text: Lat 39°53'45", long 121°12'10", in NW¼ sec.33, T.24 N., R.7 E., in intake tower No. 2 upstream from dam on Bucks Creek, 2 miles northwest of Bucks Lodge and 15 miles west of Quincy.
notes: One maximum and one minimum per water year, each with its date. Earliest printed date is Jan. 27, 1961 (water year 1961 begins October 1960). A sentence under the table gives 1928-65 extremes; not counted as table years. County is not printed.
